Problem.title: [TODO_TRANSLATE_VI] Managing salon chains fails at three things. Every existing tool falls short.
Problem.card1Desc: [TODO_TRANSLATE_VI] Across the U.S. salon industry — nail, hair, lash, brow, spa, barber, MedSpa — a large share of staff are immigrant workers with limited English. They can't read English-only UIs, let alone complex dashboards — they call daily asking how to operate. No existing tool is designed for this workforce.
Problem.card2Desc: [TODO_TRANSLATE_VI] Your best people spend hours on reconciliation, reports, and scheduling instead of serving clients and training staff. The more stores you open, the worse it gets.
Problem.card3Title: [TODO_TRANSLATE_VI] SOPs fail to replicate across stores
Problem.card3Desc: [TODO_TRANSLATE_VI] Huge efficiency gaps between best and worst stores. SOPs rely on memory; new stores drift immediately. Operational knowledge is locked in the owner's head.
Problem.callout: [TODO_TRANSLATE_VI] The problem isn't your people — it's that they're drowning in admin work. Celoria automates the busywork so your managers can get back to doing what they're good at: running a great store.
